programme.title: I was a king - Lucjan Brychczy
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Lucjan Brychczy is a true legend of Legia Warsaw. He was a man deeply experienced in life. For a child harmed by the war, football was a way to survive in difficult times. He was associated with the capital club from 1954 until his death in 2024. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E02
programme.desc: The series presents the profiles of people working behind the scenes of Polish football clubs. They perform very important duties necessary for the functioning of the team, which are often invisible to outsiders. Krzysztof Kozik has been the manager of the first team of Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza for 20 years. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. In the 1980s, he reactivated the LZS Nieciecza football club, which is an Ekstraklasa newcomer in the 2025/26 season. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

programme.title: With! | E01
programme.desc: The creators will go on a three-day expedition. Their goal is to find some of the largest sharks that inhabit the waters of our planet. They will benefit from the help of experienced hunters and animal tracking experts to see these majestic and dangerous creatures with their own eyes. In 2023, deadly shark attacks increased significantly. Their number has even doubled. The authors meet the would-be victims of these predators. They also wonder under what circumstances sharks become aggressive. Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Deadly Weather 2 | S02E06
programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Each episode presents blood-curdling footage from witnesses who survived fires, floods, tsunamis, hurricanes, avalanches, snowstorms and maritime disasters. There will also be reports from rescue operations. Recordings recorded by witnesses of disasters caused by forces of nature. A student paralyzed with fear immortalizes how a category 4 hurricane, Maria, devastates the Caribbean island of Puerto Rico. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Cheetahs on a hot plain | E03
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. A slender build, black spots on light fur, hyperventilation and regular licking to evaporate saliva - these are the cheetah's most effective tricks to help it survive in high temperatures. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Gladiators of the Animal World – River in the Jungle | E03
programme.desc: Some animals have a predisposition to fighting and facing enemies. With deadly weapons, cunning and tactics, they are born warriors of this world. The dense tropical jungle in America is teeming with life. It is inhabited by, among others, poisonous frogs, jaguars and stingrays - the gladiators of the animal kingdom. Australia. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 3 – Electric Monster | S03E05
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy goes to Brazilian. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.title: In the Shackles of Frost 4 – Winter Wraiths | S04E07
programme.desc: The fourth season of the documentary story about the fate of the inhabitants of Alaska. Sue Aikens, Jessie Holmes, Glenn Villaneuve and the Hailstones try to survive the harsh winter. For another year in a row, they take up the challenge nature throws at them. The Hailstones are working hard to develop the land they inherited from Agnes' grandparents. Jessie, on the other hand, takes part in a moose hunt. It soon turns out that he is not the only one looking for these deer. Winter is coming and Alaskans have to deal with many difficulties to wait until spring. Andy replenishes her meat supplies, and Sue must face her worst fears. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Wild Canada – Autumn | S01E03
programme.desc: Four beautifully filmed and well-edited episodes that show the history of the part of North America that lies beyond the Arctic Circle. The documentary uses incredible aerial photography and astonishing time-lapse footage. They cover areas from the east coast to the west, from the plains to the wilderness, from vast expanses of grassy prairies to the cold, lifeless landscapes of the Arctic. This is the beating heart of true wild Canada. Viewers will see the high cliffs of Newfoundland, the wild Pacific coast and the Hudson Bay area where the great migration begins. USA, Great Britain, Austria, Canada. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: The '85 Bears
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Life's Journey: Life Begins (S1E1). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2017. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep1 «Life's Journey»…For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attackWith stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the speciesDirector: Hannah Hoare, Matthew ThompsonCast: Gillian Burke

programme.title: Evolution Earth: Heat (S1E3). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep3 «Evolution Earth»…Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smallerEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Nick StringerCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smallerEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Nick StringerCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep3 «Wild Crusades»…Hidden in the jungles of Sri Lanka is the toque macaque. Dr Wolfgang Dittus is on a quest to understand their complex societySri Lanka is a stunning island country in South Asia, home for a variety of animals and plants, but also a country that is densely populated. Humans and animals often come in contact which is not a good thing. programme.title: Life's Journey: Life Begins (S1E1). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2017. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep1 «Life's Journey»…For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attackWith stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the speciesDirector: Hannah Hoare, Matthew ThompsonCast: Gillian Burke
